narr: Severe thunderstorms developed along a convergence boundary that stretched from Limon to Sterling. The storms produce hail up to an inch and a half in diameter, winds to 60 mph, two landspout tornadoes and flash flooding.
ev: US Highway 36 closed, due to hail accumulation and water on road.
County Roads department has closed CR 117 from Highway 86 south to CR 90. Reed Springs Creek is over the road.
